identity.title: CVE-2026-116211
identity.description: YesWiki 4.5.0 before 4.7.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in PageManager::save(), where the date_maj_fiche field of a Bazar entry-creation request is concatenated unescaped into an INSERT statement. Unauthenticated attackers on default installs can inject a sub-SELECT against wiki_users to exfiltrate password hashes.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

cwe_names.CWE-89: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')

_relevance.reason: Unauthenticated SQLi in YesWiki allowing password hash exfiltration, plausible public-facing web deployment.

identity.title: CVE-2026-116207
identity.description: YesWiki 4.6.0 before 4.7.0 and 5.0.0-alpha1 before 5.0.0-alpha4 contains an unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability in SearchManager::prepareSearchRequest(). Field names from the query and searchfields parameters of the public Bazar entries search API are placed in a backtick-quoted alias escaped only with mysqli_real_escape_string. Attackers can supply a backtick to inject subqueries, reading data such as user password hashes or exhausting database threads with SLEEP().

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

cwe_names.CWE-89: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')

_relevance.reason: Unauthenticated SQLi in public search API of YesWiki, plausible internet-exposed web deployment.

identity.title: CVE-2026-116201
identity.description: Snipe-IT before 8.5.0 contains a SAML assertion replay vulnerability that allows attackers to reuse captured assertions by exploiting a non-atomic nonce check in the SAML acs handler. Attackers can send concurrent POST requests to /saml/acs with one captured assertion to obtain multiple authenticated victim sessions that evade IdP-driven revocation.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: LOW, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: SAML assertion replay in Snipe-IT bypassing IdP revocation, directly impacting identity federation and session management.

identity.title: CVE-2026-116200
identity.description: Snipe-IT before 8.6.3 ignores the ldap_start_tls() return value in Ldap::connectToLdap(), allowing on-path attackers to force cleartext LDAP binds. Attackers can answer the StartTLS request with a protocol error to capture service-account credentials and end-user login passwords.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: Cleartext LDAP bind bypass in Snipe-IT enabling credential capture, directly impacting directory services and identity infrastructure.

identity.title: CVE-2026-116199
identity.description: Snipe-IT before 8.6.3 contains an authentication bypass in GoogleAuthController::handleGoogleCallback, which logs in the user whose username matches the Google account email without enforcing the activated flag. Deactivated users with email-shaped usernames and still-live Google identities can sign in via Google SSO and regain sessions at their original permission level, including admin.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: Authentication bypass via Google SSO in enterprise IT asset management software allowing deactivated users to regain admin sessions.

identity.title: CVE-2026-116195
identity.description: Rclone before 1.75.2 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the local backend's translateLink function, which trims the .rclonelink suffix from a path after the containment check, so a name can resolve outside the destination root. Attackers can plant a directory named ...rclonelink in a source tree synced with --links and --metadata to change ownership, timestamps, and xattrs of the destination's parent directory.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: REQUIRED

cwe_names.CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

_relevance.reason: Path traversal in widely deployed enterprise cloud storage sync tool affecting file system operations.

identity.title: CVE-2026-116194
identity.description: Rclone from 1.52.0 before 1.75.2 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the pCloud backend's localhost OAuth callback, which disables the state check and trusts the hostname parameter. Malicious web pages can send a stateless request to port 53682 during authorization, planting attacker tokens and API hosts so later transfers reach the attacker.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: REQUIRED

_relevance.reason: CSRF in OAuth callback allowing token planting and API host redirection in enterprise cloud sync tool.

identity.title: CVE-2026-116192
identity.description: rclone from 1.37 before 1.74.2 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to redirect http and netstorage backend requests by supplying a double-slash root on an existing named remote via --rc-serve. Attackers can make HEAD/GET requests to attacker-chosen hosts to read responses, capture configured custom headers, or obtain valid NetStorage request signatures.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

identity.title: CVE-2026-116191

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

cwe_names.CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

identity.title: CVE-2026-116189
identity.description: rclone from 1.55.0 before 1.75.2 contains a signature verification bypass in stable selfupdate that trusts checksums from unsigned bytes preceding the PGP-clearsigned SHA256SUMS block. Attackers controlling the release distribution path can prepend an unsigned checksum line matching a malicious archive, causing selfupdate to install an attacker-controlled rclone executable.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: REQUIRED

_relevance.reason: Supply chain signature bypass in Rclone self-update allowing installation of malicious executables.

identity.title: CVE-2026-116183

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE

identity.title: CVE-2026-116180
identity.description: vLLM from 0.8.5 before 0.31.0 has a denial of service flaw. LogprobsTensors.empty_cpu() in vllm/v1/outputs.py allocates an uninitialized int32 tensor, and the V1 model runner leaves prompt positions reported as computed by a KV connector unwritten. A client sharing the engine can send prompt_logprobs (or echo with logprobs) against a connector-cached prefix, making tokenizer decode raise OverflowError, which crashes EngineCore and drops all co-tenant requests.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: LOW, user interaction: NONE

_relevance.reason: Denial of service in widely deployed LLM inference engine crashing multi-tenant request handling.

barriers.summary: network, privileges: LOW, user interaction: NONE

barriers.summary: network, privileges: NONE, user interaction: NONE
